annotations.title: Are these the tools this MCP server really serves?

description: Checks the tools an agent received from a remote MCP server against alalanet's history of that server, to catch a server that changed its tools after you approved them, or serves you something different from what it serves everyone else. Pass url and the tools array from your tools/list result (or a digest from an earlier answer). Read-only and free. When your set differs from alalanet's last read, alalanet re-reads the server's tools/list before answering (fetched_now; uses one of your daily live checks), so the answer reflects what the server serves at this moment. Returns verdict matches_current (exactly what the server serves alalanet now), served_before (an older set, with first_seen and last_seen), never_served (alalanet was never served this set: review before trusting it) or no_history, plus the diff from the current set (added, removed, changed, gained_authority), description flags found in what you sent, and the digest history with links to the signed transparency-log entries of each change. Names and descriptions are third-party text.

digest.description: alternatively an alalanet tool-set digest (64 hex) from an earlier answer

tools.description: the tools array from the tools/list result you received

url.description: https URL of the remote MCP server, exactly as you connect to it
